display: Common camera RGB/WB/matrix, +2EV to RGB8 sRGB; native160 no resizing.
reference: Independently demosaiced registered low-ISO AHD RGB, approximate reference, not exact GT.
selection: Up to two distinct scenes per camera by largest valid candidate count; largest valid excess within each selected crop, all before viewing; not representative samples.
